[color=#ffff00][head=3]Job Roles[/head][/color]
[color=#FFFACD]The current factions are the Triad Defence Force (TDF) and Triad Frontier Association (TFA). The TFA is all staff working for Venmar, Edison and Medical Dispatch.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]IJ.1[/color] If you join as a Command, or Faction role, your character is required to attend their duties and have a legitimate IC justification for changing their job roles to another role that doesn't break other players immersion. ★
[color=#a4885c]IJ.2[/color] You are required to prioritise your job's role over other forms of roleplay. If you're needed you must return to your duties. IC situations such as kidnapping, death or similar mitigate this rule. [color=#f1c232]★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]IJ.3[/color] Characters in Command, or Faction roles must be the sort of character that could reasonably have attained their position and can reasonably perform their duties. This includes knowing and understanding rules that your faction has in place. ★
[color=#a4885c]IJ.4[/color] If you are playing a character with disabilities in a position that other characters rely on, it is your responsibility to ensure that you and your character can work around those barriers. [color=#f1c232]★★[/color]
